title: SCHC sender creation races rotation and can return stale ready capabilities
description: Security review: create_sender reads generation, unlocks, binds, then relocks to register. Rotation in either gap misses the sender and can return a stale status=ready capability that was never invalidated. Make generation capture, binding, and registration atomic with rotation (or register a locked placeholder); barrier test guarantees returned sender is valid pre-rotation and invalidated or valid post-rotation, never stale-ready.
